step1_analysis.description: A series stack of four NMOS transistors used as a high-voltage tolerant switch in an AC plasma display panel driver. The stacked configuration distributes high voltage stress across multiple devices, though in this scaled 1.8V testbench it operates as a standard pull-down network.

paper_reference.title: Multilevel Voltage Wave-Shaping Display Driver for AC Plasma Display Panel Application

v_out_on.description: Output voltage when the switch stack is fully ON.

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to an extraction artifact where XM4's bulk is tied to its gate (LABEL_NET_5) instead of source, a forward-biased diode injects current into N2 when the gate is driven to 1.8V. N2 settles at ~1V (1.8V - Vdiode). The output LABEL_NET_4 pulls down to ~1V instead of 0V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the voltage divider between the forward-biased bulk-source diode of XM4 and the ON-resistance of the lower three transistors (XM3, XM1, XM2).

t_fall.description: Fall time of the output node when the switch turns ON.

sky130_expected.calculation: Time constant of the stack's ON resistance (~1 kOhm) discharging a 1 pF load capacitor is ~1 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down significantly from the paper's high-voltage, high-capacitance (66 nF) discrete power devices to SKY130 on-chip dimensions.

i_leakage.description: Leakage current through the switch stack when OFF.

sky130_expected.calculation: Subthreshold leakage of 4 series NMOS devices with W=5u, L=0.5u.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Series stacking significantly reduces leakage due to the stack effect.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the switching characteristics, ON-state voltage, and OFF-state leakage of the stacked NMOS switch.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Multilevel Voltage Wave-Shaping Display Driver Switch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

XM1 N1 LABEL_NET_0 N4 N4 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 LABEL_NET_3 N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 LABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_5 N2 LABEL_NET_5 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 N4 N4 N4 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 N4 N4 N4 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 N3 N0 N0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Power supply and load
VDD VDD 0 1.8
V_meas VDD VDD_meas 0
R_pullup VDD_meas LABEL_NET_4 10k
C_load LABEL_NET_4 0 1p

* Gate drives
V_g1 LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
V_g2 LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
V_g3 LABEL_NET_3 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
V_g4 LABEL_NET_5 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)

* Dummy resistors for floating nodes (artifacts from extraction)
R_dummy1 N3 0 1G
R_dummy2 N0 0 1G

.control
tran 10p 20n

* Measure ON and OFF voltages
meas tran v_out_off find v(LABEL_NET_4) at=1n
meas tran v_out_on find v(LABEL_NET_4) at=10n

* Measure currents (Note: I(V_meas) is negative when flowing from VDD to circuit)
meas tran i_leak find i(V_meas) at=1n
meas tran i_on find i(V_meas) at=10n

* Measure fall time (target 1.4V due to bulk diode clamping artifact on XM4)
meas tran t_fall trig v(LABEL_NET_1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(LABEL_NET_4) val=1.4 fall=1

quit
.endc
